limitations: Only the named reflex/mechanism coordinates are modeled; no3Dhuman/CAD coverage is inherited or required before scoped training.
Source fixed-reset LIF and additive/capped event synapses are tested as their exact functions; adaptive-threshold GLIF and reset-to-peak Eq.27/29 synapses are not claimed installed.
design_scope_policy: Account for every source coordinate as neural, passive, constraint, apparatus, or unsupported. Free3Dwalking/wholebody success is not a prerequisite for supported/reduced-scope Hunt training.

applicable_design_operations.signal_scale: Declare actualsource and independent desired domains; no inherited globalpass.
applicable_design_operations.passive_membrane: Derive localCfrom physicaltau and leak/backgroundconductance with actualclock.
applicable_design_operations.graded_synapse: Exact single-path endpoint conductance derivation available; multiinput/transient/linearitychecks stillrequired.
applicable_design_operations.GLIF_threshold_steps: Notapplicableto gradedcells; separate pureGLIFprofile requiresall activation/transient/rate contracts.
applicable_design_operations.spike_synapse: Declare reset-to-peak vs additive/capped eventlaw beforeusingdelta/Eq28/29.

desired_functional_contract.input_domain: Declared electrical source input:0..5.3nA; fixedLIF threshold/deadband and exact nonlinear f-I retained.
desired_functional_contract.output_domain: Actual neuron Vm/rate plus chemical [g,gE]; mean signed currents atdeclaredVm fromeventrecipe.
desired_functional_contract.target_gain: Exact source RC and fixed-resetLIF functions; independent +/-1nA event-current target at100Hz.
desired_functional_contract.status: Actual source block/chemical-port contracts; no pureGLIF adaptive-threshold replacement claimed.

application_recipe.default_behavior: No profile: literal no-op; no original source or topology changes.
application_recipe.ionic_exclusion: NaP/Ca m/h and adaptation currents are not GLIF adaptive-threshold m/tau_theta; retain source mechanism unless a separately verified replacement is declared.

example.warning: Apply to a separate passive block/model via set_param; no whole-model or ionic rescaling.

source_preserving_rate_contract.recipe: Retainactualresetandderiveexactcurrent↔rate law forchosenrange, ORexplicitlydeclare newreset-at-restTable2primitive. Do not silentlyreplaceonewiththeother.

review_required: Parent review ofreflex/mechanism scope; no coupled wholebody or adaptation claim.

bilateral_design_accounting.policy: Unilateral antagonist primitive/mechanism; flexor/extensor cells are functionally different, not left/right homologues. No bilateral fitting variables exist.
